verdict.rationale: LegalZoom has an annual-report service page offering real-time compliance-status notifications from the state filing office, and its registered-agent offering sends annual report deadline reminders through a Compliance Calendar. That supports staying on time, but no quoted evidence explicitly says LegalZoom files the annual report for you, and franchise tax is never mentioned. missing for 10: explicit documentation that LegalZoom prepares and submits annual reports, any franchise tax filing or payment capability, state coverage details, independent or hands-on corroboration of on-time filing.

support.subject: As a founder, I can file annual reports and franchise tax on time through the platform

citations.quote: Real-time notifications about your compliance status, upon receipt of data from your state filing office
get reminders when annual report deadlines are approaching
Email reminders about annual report deadlines through the Compliance Calendar
